<!-- pr-reviewer: 7ceb09480f330252215bfcf4e437db2272c4598d -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blocker. The PR stays a draft on purpose.

## What looks good

- The PR changes only `examples/first-router-part.camproj` and `examples/first-router-part.nc`. No code changes.
- The body names the three non-cache lines of the `.camproj` with their source commits (`afa612d2f`, `2fdc4200f`). It has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #3698`.
- The committed files equal what the code generates: `git status --short` is empty after all four test runs.

## Reading of the `.nc` (checked by a diff, not by eye)

- Only the `2D Contour1` section changes (lines 84-130). Outside it, no line differs. The line count stays at 165.
- Depths (Z-4, Z-8, Z-9, tab level Z-12), feeds (F400 plunge, F1800 cut), S9500 and the Z15 and Z2 heights are the same. The drill and pocket sections are the same.
- The levels Z-4, Z-8 and Z-9 now start at X176 Y80.991 and enter at X173 Y77.991. This is the start of the tabbed Z-12 level, which does not change.
- Outside lead: the contour is an Outside contour with a tool radius of 3 mm. The part outline is X30..170, Y30..130. The tool centre path is X27..173, Y27..133. The lead-in is an arc of radius 3 from X176 Y80.991 to X173 Y77.991. The lead-out is an arc from X173 Y77.991 to X176 Y74.991. Both stay at X173 or more, so they stay outside the part outline (X170). The closed loop returns to X173 Y77.991 before the lead-out.
- Stepdown: the stock is 200 x 160 x 12 and the stepdown is 4 mm. All levels plunge at the same point X176 Y80.991, which is in stock beside the part. The plunge depths are Z-4, Z-8, Z-9 and Z-12. Each plunge goes at most one stepdown (4 mm) below material that the level above already cut at that point.

## Reading of the `.camproj` (JSON diff, old and new loaded, all paths compared)

197 values differ. All are one of these:
- `/version`: 73 to 78
- `/machine/machine/kind`: `mill` to `router`
- `/machine/machine/post`: added, `grblHAL`
- `from`, `to` and `arc` of cached moves of entity 0 (`2D Contour1`). The number of moves is the same.

No operation parameter, no stamp and no other cache (`2D Pocket1`, `Drill1`) changes.

## Results (locally, in a worktree trial-merged with main `81643a2a4`, debug, `-j 6`)

| Binary | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app --test first_router_part` | 4 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test first_part_programs` | 2 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test example_catalog` | 39 passed, 4 ignored |
| `camcraft-app --test docs_troubleshooting` | 2 passed |

No clippy run: the PR has no code change. No runner run.

## Heavy lanes

Not run. The diff changes only data files in `examples/`. The PR body also says that no heavy lane ran. The release gate at the cut stays the final check.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The op stamp salt is not bumped, as the body says. A project that a user saved before #3684 keeps the old contour start until the user regenerates the operation. The body says this. A follow-up issue is optional.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
